own_solution.law: Rutherford closest approach r_min = (D/2)(1 + 1/sin(theta/2)), D = 2 Z k e^2 / K
assumptions: pure Coulomb force between 2e and Ze

TA405.regime: closest approach exceeds the nuclear radius

T69BD.regime: closest approach exceeds the nuclear radius

defect_reasons.other: The certified 54.9159 fm appears to convert MeV to joules with the exact CODATA e (1.602176634e-19) rather than the stated e = 1.602e-19 C; using the stated e throughout gives 54.922 fm, a 0.011% difference well within the four-figure precision of the given constants.

notes: Strata agree with pass 1. R answers scale as 5/(5+q): 54.9159*5/8 = 34.322, *5/8.6 = 31.928, *5/9.2 = 29.846 fm, all verified. K regime d > q holds for all listed radii (6.6-7.5 fm) with d = 54.9 fm; also with the R boosts the closest approach (about 30-34 fm) stays well outside the nucleus. Strictly the contact distance is nuclear plus alpha radius, which does not change the conclusion. Minimal pairs TE67A/T9A84 (earlier vs this scattering) and TABD0/T850C (protons vs alpha particles) share 3.6 MeV and differ only in attachment; T381B and T5616 are declared numeral-free controls with matching wording. Pass 1 answer was 54.92 fm (5.492e-14 m), consistent.
